user.description: You need a personal API key from NVE HydAPI to use this integration. Create or find your key at [hydapi.nve.no/Users]({api_key_url}).

data_description.api_key: Paste the API key from NVE HydAPI. The key is stored locally in Home Assistant.
data_description.scan_interval: The recommended interval is 15 minutes. The minimum is 10 minutes. Series are fetched together where possible. Multiple resolutions or versions of the same parameter at one station are fetched in separate requests to avoid mixing measurements.

data_description.station_id: Start typing a station name or station ID and select one of the live suggestions to load its available data series.

data_description.custom_name: Can only be used when selecting one series. Sensors can also be renamed later in Home Assistant.

continue.description: The selected series are ready to save. Submit to finish, or select the option below to search another station.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API key
reauth_confirm.description: HydAPI rejected the stored API key. The new API key is checked before it is saved. Stations, measurement series and sensor IDs are preserved. Create a key at [NVE HydAPI]({api_key_url}).

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: The new API key is checked before it is saved. Stations, measurement series and sensor IDs are preserved. Create a key at [NVE HydAPI]({api_key_url}).

init.title: Updates and measurement series
init.description:
Change how often data is fetched and manage the selected measurement series. Series are fetched together where possible. Multiple resolutions or versions of the same parameter at one station are fetched separately.

**Current setup:** {station_count} stations and {series_count} measurement series.

data_description.scan_interval: The recommended interval is 15 minutes because HydAPI/Sildre data is normally not updated continuously. The minimum is 10 minutes.
data_description.action: Keep the current series, add series from an active station, or remove a configured series.

data_description.station_id: Start typing a station name or station ID and select one of the live suggestions to load its available data series.

data_description.custom_name: Can only be used when selecting one series. Sensors can also be renamed later in Home Assistant.

continue.description: The selected series are ready to save. Submit to finish, or select the option below to search another station.

remove.description: Select the measurement series to remove. Review and confirm the consequences before anything changes.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm removal
confirm_remove.description:
**{series}**

The measurement and its status sensor are removed from Home Assistant's entity registry. If this is the station's last series, this integration is also detached from the station device.

The integration does not directly delete history. Home Assistant retention rules still apply, and adding the series again may not reconnect its history. Update automations and dashboards that use these sensors.

Leave the checkbox empty to return without removing the series.
